author: FlatsoWeirdo20
quote: I do not believe this game deserves its 99 Critical rating, nor does it deserve a higher user score. Both the 99 and a higher user score are extremely inaccurate to the general quality of GTA VI. Now, I do not hate anyone who likes this game and are having fun with it. They are fine to like what they like. But I feel that it is very dishonest to say that this game is even remotely above games like GTA V, Super Mario Odyssey, RDR2, or even OOT (1998). I'd say that this game is a 4.5 - 5/10 (45 or 50 out of 100). I do understand why this game is a big deal, but I think that this game should be a wake-up call to Rockstar that whatever they're doing is not working. I hope people find this review helpful.
